title: all most some any no/none
summary: Слова all, most, some, any, no/none: без of в общих утверждениях, с of перед the/my/these и местоимениями (most of them).
ru:
## Слова количества
**all, most, some, any, no / none** показывают, какая часть: все, большинство, некоторые, никакие.
| | значение |
|---|---|
| **all** | все |
| **most** | большинство |
| **some** | некоторые, несколько |
| **any** | какие-нибудь (в вопросах и отрицаниях) |
| **no / none** | никакие |

## Без of: вообще, в целом
Когда говорим о людях и предметах **вообще**, слово ставим прямо перед существительным — **без of** и **без the**:
> **Most people** drive too fast. — Большинство людей ездит слишком быстро.
> **Some birds** can't fly. — Некоторые птицы не умеют летать.
> **All cities** have problems. — У всех городов есть проблемы.
> He's got **no friends**. — У него нет друзей.

## С of: конкретные люди и вещи
Когда речь о **конкретной группе** (the, this, my, these...), нужно **of**:
> **Most of the children** at this school are under 11. — Большинство детей в этой школе младше 11.
> **Some of these books** are very old. — Некоторые из этих книг очень старые.
> **None of my friends** live near me. — Никто из моих друзей не живёт рядом.
С **all** слово **of** обычно опускают: *all the students, all my life*.

## all of it / most of them / none of us
Если существительное не называем, ставим **of + it / them / us / you**:
> You can have some of this cake, but not **all of it**. — Можно взять часть торта, но не весь.
> Do you know those people? — **Most of them**, but not **all of them**.
> **Some of us** are going out tonight. — Некоторые из нас идут гулять.
> How many books have you read? — **None of them.**

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Most of people like music.~~ → **Most people** like music.
- ~~Some of birds can't fly.~~ → **Some birds** can't fly.
- ~~Most the students passed.~~ → **Most of the** students passed.
en:
## Quantity words
**all, most, some, any, no / none** tell us how many: everyone, nearly everyone, a few, not any.

## Without of: in general
We use these words **directly before a noun** (no *the*, no *of*) when we speak about things in general:
> **Most people** drive too fast.
> **Some birds** can't fly.
> **All cities** have problems.
> He's got **no friends**.

## With of: specific people and things
When we mean a specific group (the, this, my, these ...), we need **of**:
> **Most of the children** at this school are under 11.
> **Some of these books** are very old.
> **None of my friends** live near me.
With **all**, we usually leave out of: *all the students, all my life*.

## all of it / most of them / none of us
Without a noun we use **of + it / them / us / you**:
> You can have some of this cake, but not **all of it**.
> Do you know those people? — **Most of them**, but not **all of them**.
> **Some of us** are going out tonight.
> How many books have you read? — **None of them.**

## Common mistakes
- ~~Most of people like music.~~ → **Most people** like music.
- ~~Some of birds can't fly.~~ → **Some birds** can't fly.
- ~~Most the students passed.~~ → **Most of the** students passed.
structure:
## Без of и с of
| В общем | Конкретно |
|---|---|
| all / most / some / any / no + noun | all (of) / most of / some of / any of / none of + **the / this / my / these ...** + noun |
| Most people like music. | Most of the people here like music. |
| Some books are good. | Some of my books are good. |

## Формулы
> **most / some / any** + существительное (в общем)
> **most of / some of / any of / none of** + **the / my / this / these** + существительное
> **all of it / most of them / some of us / none of you** (местоимение)

## Особенности
> **all** + the / my — обычно без of: *all the students, all my life*
> **no** + noun, **none** (of) без noun
> **not ... any**: *I don't want any of this money.*

exercises.title: Вставьте of, если нужно
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **of**, если нужно. Если не нужно, напишите **-**.

items.text: Some {{of}} these books are very old.
Most {{of}} the shops in the city are closed on Sunday.
I didn't read any {{of}} these books.
Some {{-}} children are afraid of dogs.
You can have some of this cake, but not all of {{it}}.
I know most of {{them}}, but not all of them.
Some of {{us}} are going to the cinema. Would you like to come?
How many of these books have you read? — None of {{them}}.
Do you want some of this cheese? — No, I don't want any of {{it}}.
Most of {{you}} have done the work. Well done!
